user_query: I'm planning a trip to Argentina and I want to stay updated on the latest trends and events in the country. Can you fetch the trending hashtags in Argentina using the Get country's hashtags API and provide me with some interesting Instagram posts related to those hashtags using the get API? This will help me discover popular places and activities to explore during my trip.

TaskList.description: Fetch the trending hashtags in Argentina using the relevant API.
Get interesting Instagram posts related to the trending hashtags obtained from Step 1.
